terms.name: RF receive: RX SMA to the challenge's bit in the FPGA
terms.source: model: A, rev A's registered A3 decoder (PLAN.md 19, row 0 less its TX); B, B2's first edge into one or two fabric clocks at 100 MHz, the slow path a veto, not a wait; C, rev B's LVDS comparators into a LUT (row 3)

terms.name: combine the verifiers' bits: f = XOR or a small hash
terms.source: model: one clock at 100 MHz, or a LUT level

terms.name: the basis out to the BME driver: a 5 V buffer and 1 m of cable
terms.source: SyzygyRadioBoard review 1: the Pockels path 1.4-9.5 ns on its board (SN74ACT04 x6, 15 ohm); 1 m of coax 3.9 ns

terms.name: BME PCD-dpp: trigger to the cell settled in its basis
terms.source: manual: 4-7 ns edges, >= 3 V (4 V) into 50 ohm, 50 ns minimum On-to-Off; the trigger-to-output delay is not in it (est 15-40 ns); a Leysop RTP cell is a few pF (6 pF for the RTP-4-20) with little piezo ringing (est 3-10 ns to settle)

terms.name: the photon after the cell: PBS and fibre to the detector
detector: photon to its output pulse
terms.source: est: InGaAs SPAD modules (ID Qube, ID120) do not publish it (A, B); an SNSPD's own latency is ps, its amplifiers and ~2 m of coax out of the cryostat about 10-20 ns (C)

terms.name: the detector's cable to the prover's box
detector pulse in to the answer on the TX ladder pins
terms.source: model: rev A's TRIG IN (1 k into a Schmitt buffer) on clock-capable pin 26, then one or two clocks; rev B a buffer and a LUT

terms.name: constant-time release: the detection window's width
terms.source: a click and a no-click leave at the same time after the window (the detector's jitter and the photon's timing)

terms.name: RF transmit: ladder, modulator, to the TX SMA (50 %)
terms.source: model: sim/latency_roadmap.py (PYNQ's 200 ohm; a bare or LVDS pin)

terms.name: antenna cables at the prover, receive and transmit, 1 m each
terms.source: 3.9 ns/m each way; a box behind the antenna.  10 m each way would be 78 ns

A.label: rev A, the gateware as planned (the registered A3 decoder), InGaAs SPADs

B.label: rev A, a robust fast gateware path (first edge, slow-path veto), InGaAs SPADs

C.label: rev B on a Brain-1 (LVDS, combinational paths), SNSPDs
